USEC: [[Lighthouse]] |given by =[[Jaeger]] |reward = |reputation = |time limit = |quest number = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Notes== Depending on the faction of the player there are different dialogues and objectives. ==Dialogue== ====BEAR Exclusive==== {{quote|In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be defeated that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the Reserve base, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.}} ====USEC Exclusive==== {{quote|You're not one of us, of course, but I can tell there's something in you... something that understands. In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be crushed that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the water treatment plant, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.}} ==Requirements== * Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Jaeger]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== ====BEAR Exclusive==== * Launch a yellow signal flare at the train depot on [[Reserve]] * Eliminate any 6 targets at the train depot on [[Reserve]] '''Note:''' The "Eliminate" objective will appear after the "Launch a yellow signal flare" objective is completed. ====USEC Exclusive==== * Eliminate any 6 targets at the train station territory on [[Lighthouse]] * Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station on [[Lighthouse]] '''Note:''' The "Eliminate" objective will appear after the "Launch a yellow signal flare" objective is completed. ==Rewards== * +28,600 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,050 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 ====BEAR Exclusive==== {{quote|You and I make a fine team.}} ====USEC Exclusive==== {{quote|Surprisingly, the two of us make a good team.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Yellow flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the train area. |- ! colspan="6" |OR |- ![[File:SP-81 Icon.png|link=ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |[[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to fire the flare cartridge. |- ![[File:26x75 flare cartridge (Yellow) icon.png|link=26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the train area. |} In this quest you first have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being inside the train area on [[Reserve]] or [[Lighthouse]], depending on your faction. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]] which can be bought at [[Prapor]] LL1 or a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)|26x75mm yellow flare cartridge]] which can be bought at [[Jaeger]] LL1, and is fired from a [[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol|signal pistol]]. If you use the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]], make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards you have to kill any 6 targets in the area in the same raid.
